sources.limitations: The Public Defender represents eligible clients in matters within its remit, not general civil complaint intake. The appointment link on the official site uses a different legacy domain; the general office contact is published in the footer. Confirm jurisdiction, current mailbox and appropriate remit. Deliverability not tested. Do not send confidential records through ordinary email.
